Dependency register schema version; required value is v3.1.
Dependency classification enum: ANCHOR or EXECUTION.
Anchor classification: IMPLEMENTS_NODE, TRACES_TO_REQUIREMENT, NOT_APPLICABLE.
Error type carrying a dependency contract error code and details.
Lifecycle status of a dependency: TBD, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SATISFIED, WAIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
Resolved harness options passed to engine adapters (persona, mode, model).
Engine adapter interface exposing subject, startTurn, and interrupt.
Engine adapter identity: stub, anthropic-direct, or claude-agent-sdk.
Streamed harness UI event; public set allowlisted by PUBLIC_UI_EVENT_NAMES.
Record of a delegated/observed subagent child run with capability policy and governance.
Agent classification: PERSONA or TASK.
Loaded agent instruction with instructionRoot, path, and content.
Harness error type with a type code (e.g. SDK_FAILURE, PERSONA_NOT_FOUND, ATTACHMENT_FAILURE) and status.
Interface for agent SDK managers providing startTurn and interrupt.
Deterministic stub SDK manager that streams chunked responses and honors test markers.
Anthropic-backed SDK manager that streams real messages.create responses under outbound policy.
Selected workspace root path used across panels and providers.
Local non-authoritative harness options (model, tools, maxTurns, subagentGovernance).
Block of turn content (text or file attachment) sent to the engine adapter.
UI-side attachment descriptor with path, displayName, and clientType.
